basis: The root asserts a property of Venus's rotation, comparing it to the rotation of other planets.
children: Venus spins slowly in the opposite direction from most planets.
scoped_obligations: The scope of 'most planets' is unclear. It could refer to all known planets, or a subset defined by some implicit criteria (e.g., planets in our solar system, gas giants, terrestrial planets).
The phrase 'opposite direction' is ambiguous. It could mean a retrograde rotation (opposite to the direction of the planet's orbit), or simply a different rotational axis.
